core_obligations: Statement (lines 3001-3024): with X_n = (g_{n!}Z) tensor^L_Z K and Y_n = (g_{n!}Z -> ... -> g_{0!}Z)[-n] tensor^L_Z K, the distinguished triangles Y_n -> X_n -> Y_{n-1} -> Y_n[1] form a Postnikov system for ... -> X_2 -> X_1 -> X_0 and K = hocolim Y_n[n] in D(C_total).

Special case K = Z (proof lines 3026-3036): this is the Derived Categories key example applied to the resolution complex ... -> g_{2!}Z -> g_{1!}Z -> g_{0!}Z, which represents K = Z by the simplicial Z resolution lemma.
General case (lines 3036-3043): the general K follows because the exact functor - tensor^L_Z K sends Postnikov systems to Postnikov systems and commutes with homotopy colimits.
proof_roadmap: Prove the K = Z case by the key Postnikov example applied to the Z resolution.
Transport to general K by exactness properties of derived tensor.
difficulty_reason: Postnikov-system lemma (statement 3001-3024, proof 3026-3043): the abelian-case Postnikov system - same structure as the module variant: special case via the key example on the Z resolution (represented as Z by the in-source resolution lemma), general case by the two exactness properties of derived tensor; complete reduction. H2.
